name: Taren_Natural
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. LATTICE dialogue portrait atlas. Produce exactly ONE square sheet containing FOUR equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows of head-and-shoulders portraits of the SAME adult Vael alien, sixteen separate cells total.
